Rock faces & mountains

Compare the original Gen 3 maps, our Johto conversions, and original Gen 4 source artwork. Start with the overview, then select a collection. Use the IDs when choosing a style. All images use nearest-neighbor enlargement.

This is the comparison stage. No artwork has been standardized or installed. Raw DS textures show unlit source colors and texture layouts; they are not finished GBA tiles. Source maps show how the art looks in context.

Read each row left to right: original GBA example → current Johto conversion → original HGSS map. Then compare the family sheets. We can choose a face, top/cap, edge, base transition and cave entrance separately.
